summary: Frontend-only verification of Status column addition in GHG Logs (Scope 1/2/3/Biogenic) and removal of Quantity column from Scope 1 & 2. Logged in as admin and navigated to /ghg/scope1, then switched through all 4 tabs. All Status column rendering, badge text, badge color classes, and column alignment match the specification. Quantity column is not present on Scope 1 or Scope 2.
critical_code_review_comments: EmissionDataGrid.jsx is now ~500 lines and has 3 near-duplicate row/header blocks (scope1/2, scope3, biogenic). Consider extracting per-scope row components to reduce duplication (DRY).
The Status cell markup is duplicated 4x across scopes; extract a <StatusBadge status={emission.approval_status} /> component using getStatusDisplay.
getStatusDisplay handles 'pending_delete' as 'Pending delete' (red) instead of a 'Completed, ...' variant — inconsistent with the new 'Completed, X' pattern; confirm this is intentional.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified Status column implementation in /app/frontend/src/pages/emissions/components/EmissionDataGrid.jsx across all 4 GHG scope tabs. Observed live badges: 'Completed' (stone/gray), 'Completed, Awaiting approval' (amber) on Scope 2, and 'Completed, Approved' (green) on Scope 2 and Biogenic. Did not encounter any 'Completed, Rejected' record in current dataset — if that state needs coverage, create a rejected pending_records row and re-verify. Quantity column confirmed removed from Scope 1 and Scope 2 headers.
